summary: TFI International filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) announcing that Steve Mayer will join its Board of Directors effective October 29, 2026. The press release highlights Mayer's 30-plus years in investment banking at Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley and Greenhill, where he is President of Greenhill Canada, and cites his Canadian-US M&A and capital markets expertise. Chairman, President and CEO Alain Bedard welcomed him. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor mandate, regulatory clock or shareholder vote is disclosed; this is a routine board appointment, not a special situation.
